This is fairly old data, but still relevant. In 1964-65 (the last school year before the Higher Education Act was signed), the average undergraduate tuition in 2006 dollars (including room and board) at public universities was $950. By 2006-07, it had skyrocketed to $11,034. At private universities, the average tuition was $1,907 in 1964-65. By 2006-07, it was a whopping $28,384. It's no coincidence that the cost of higher education quickly started becoming unreasonable once the government stepped in with loans and removed any incentive to charge an affordable rate.
